subject.title: [Bug]: Subagent completion silently lost — no retry, no notification, no auto-restart on timeout

question: Which durable subagent completion policy should own this umbrella before more fixes are queued or the linked retry PR is accepted?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the permanent fix changes at-least-once delivery, visible failure semantics, timeout/restart behavior, and duplicate-prevention across agent and channel surfaces.

options.title: Sponsor durable completion delivery
options.body: Keep this issue as the umbrella and define a durable inbox/outbox or equivalent state machine before landing retry-only changes.

options.title: Narrow to linked retry PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90561 as a near-term mitigation only after it has live proof and maintainers accept the retry-timing tradeoff.

options.title: Split by failure mode
options.body: Move steered-transcript races, timeout/prune notifications, and restart durability into explicitly owned narrower issues before demoting this umbrella.

recommendation.title: Sponsor durable completion delivery
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the umbrella and define a durable inbox/outbox or equivalent state machine before landing retry-only changes.

likelyOwner.reason: The broad delivery-state and lifecycle boundary decision best matches the recent subagent registry helper/lifecycle refactor ownership trail.
